lines.text: Your server died at 3am. Your app didn't.
lines.spoken: Your server died at 3 a.m. Your app didn't.

lines.text: That's Kubernetes. It runs your apps and keeps them running.
lines.spoken: That's Kubernetes. It runs your apps and keeps them running.

lines.text: Each box is a pod: your app, packed in a container.
lines.spoken: Each box is a pod: your app, packed in a container.

lines.text: Pods run on nodes. A node is just a machine.
lines.spoken: Pods run on nodes. A node is just a machine.

lines.text: Many nodes together make a cluster.
lines.spoken: Many nodes together make a cluster.

lines.text: The control plane is the brain. You tell it what you want.
lines.spoken: The control plane is the brain. You tell it what you want.

lines.text: Say you want 3 copies. It starts 3 pods.
lines.spoken: Say you want three copies. It starts three pods.

lines.text: When one pod dies, it notices and starts another.
lines.spoken: When one pod dies, it notices and starts another.

lines.text: Traffic spikes? Change 3 to 10. It adds 7 more.
lines.spoken: Traffic spikes? Change three to ten. It adds seven more.

lines.text: A service gives those pods one stable address.
lines.spoken: A service gives those pods one stable address.

lines.text: Say what you want. Kubernetes keeps it true.
lines.spoken: Say what you want. Kubernetes keeps it true.
